headline: Australian Regulator Threatens Legal Action Over Superannuation Complaints
summary: Australia's corporate watchdog warned superannuation funds of potential legal action if they fail to improve their resolution of member complaints.
why: Australia's superannuation industry manages over A$3.5 trillion in pension assets; stricter regulatory enforcement raises compliance scrutiny and potential penalty costs.

impacts.name: Australian Superannuation Funds
impacts.why: Regulator threats of litigation over complaints handling heighten legal and operational risks for pension managers.
